C1069.title: Man Sentenced to 3.5 Years for Installing Hidden Cameras in Hotels to Film 51 Couples
keywords: producing selling disseminating obscene materials for profit
C1069.summary: Starting November 2017, the unemployed Qian purchased multiple covert recording devices and installed them in multiple hotel rooms, secretly filming sexual acts of 51 couples of guests, saving edited videos to internet cloud storage, and posting sale information via illegal websites and instant messaging software. Qian also provided internet links 182 times for others to watch live or download videos via the covert devices through a 'paid monthly subscription' model. On July 26, 2019, the Jinjiang District Court of Chengdu sentenced Qian to 3 years 6 months for producing, selling, and disseminating obscene materials for profit, plus a 5,000 yuan fine. This is SPP Guiding Case No. 139 (34th batch).
